verdicts.note: Attorney for 12 years with no judicial experience, challenging a judge in office since 2009 (S2). +1 medium fits; nothing in the dossier makes a stronger outsider/renewal case. Display note: the highlight 'advocate for the planned justice center [S2]' adds 'planned', which the dossier doesn't support; S2 quotes only 'strong advocacy for the justice center'. Drop 'planned'.
On the bench since 2009; won in 2010, 2014 and 2018 and was unopposed in 2022 (S1-S5); 'When voting for judges, experience matters' (S1).

Documented diversion/problem-solving-court evidence as the guide requires: she helped build Veterans Court, Therapeutic Drug Court, 24/7 alcohol monitoring and expanded probation 'aimed at protecting our citizens and supporting rehabilitation' (S1), alongside 'holding offenders accountable' (S1). Her former-prosecutor background (S1) leans toward enforcement, but the therapeutic-court record offsets it. 0 at medium (genuinely mixed) holds.
